```{r}
df_nitrogen <- corn_all %>%
  select(
    N_Treatment,
    DAP,
    ID,
    NNI,
    `PNC_g/kg`,
    `PNU_kg/ha`
  )

df_nitrogen %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(
      NNI,
    `PNC_g/kg`,
    `PNU_kg/ha`
    ),
    names_to = "parameter",
    values_to = "value"
  ) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = value)) +
  geom_density(
    fill = "steelblue",
    alpha = 0.5,
    na.rm = TRUE
  ) +
  facet_wrap(
    ~ parameter,
    scales = "free"
  ) +
  theme_bw()

```

```{r}
df_nitrogen %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(
      NNI,
      `PNC_g/kg`,
      `PNU_kg/ha`
    ),
    names_to = "parameter",
    values_to = "value"
  ) %>%
  ggplot(aes(
    x = N_Treatment,
    y = value,
    fill = N_Treatment
  )) +
  geom_boxplot(
    alpha = 0.6,
    outlier.shape = NA
  ) +
  geom_jitter(
    width = 0.15,
    alpha = 0.4,
    size = 1.5
  ) +
  facet_wrap(
    ~ parameter,
    scales = "free_y"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Corn Nitrogen Status by Fertilization Treatment",
    x = "Nitrogen Treatment",
    y = "Measured Value"
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none"
  )
```

```{r}
df_nitrogen %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(
      NNI,
      `PNC_g/kg`,
      `PNU_kg/ha`
    ),
    names_to = "parameter",
    values_to = "value"
  ) %>%
  ggplot(aes(
    x = factor(DAP),
    y = value,
    fill = N_Treatment
  )) +
  geom_boxplot(
    alpha = 0.7,
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.8)
  ) +
  facet_wrap(
    ~ parameter,
    scales = "free_y"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Corn Nitrogen Status Across Sampling Dates",
    x = "Days After Planting",
    y = "Measured Value",
    fill = "N Treatment"
  ) +
  theme_bw()
```
